WITH total_execs AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM orders o
  INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
)
SELECT 
  o.orderflow,
  AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_fillcount,
  COUNT(*) as execution_count,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL) / CAST((SELECT total_count FROM total_execs) AS DECIMAL) as fraction
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
GROUP BY o.orderflow

assumptions.assumption: SQL's AVG() function, which ignores NULL values by default while counting zero values as zero, correctly interprets 'ignoring missing values but counting zero fills as zero'
The fraction denominator is the total count of execution records across all order statuses (not weighted by order count or other metrics)
